source: Written by hand on 2026-11-04 from the public facility list of athletics.snu.ac.kr (스포츠진흥원, /facility/list) and P13's spec, and checked against the Places of this seed. Each entry names a Place by its number, or by its name where the seed holds it without one, with the page where that Place's facilities are booked. A Place that holds several bookable facilities links athletics' list page. ssims.snu.ac.kr (예약하샤) is linked by its index until its deep links are checked in a browser.
